name: Bay Area Park & Ride Lots
description: Free parking lots for carpoolers, vanpoolers, and transit riders
fullDescription: Free parking lots located near major transit hubs and freeway on-ramps throughout the Bay Area, allowing commuters to park and continue their trip via transit, carpool, or vanpool.
whatTheyOffer:
- Over 150 free Park & Ride lots across the Bay Area and nearby counties
- Many lots are close to transit connections; some have bike lockers or racks
- Convenient for carpool and vanpool meetups
- Reduces single-occupancy vehicle trips
- Open to all commuters
howToGetIt:
1. Visit 511.org to search Park & Ride lots by county or view them on the interactive map
2. Check lot details (spaces, bike parking, lighting, transit access)
3. Drive to lot and park in designated spaces
4. Continue commute via transit, carpool, or vanpool
5. Some lots may have time limits or overnight restrictions
keywords: Park and Ride, free parking, BART, Caltrain, transit hub, carpool, vanpool, commuter, 511
